title: A Notebook of Better Questions
title_ja: より良い問いのノート
fact_notes: 登場人物・出来事は架空の教材例。実在の調査結果ではない。リンクは制作台帳であり実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: Riku joined a study group to prepare for a geography examination.
sentences.ja: リクは地理の試験に備え学習グループに入った。

sentences.en: Each member brought a notebook filled with facts from the textbook.
sentences.ja: 各自が教科書の事実を記したノートを持参した。

sentences.en: They read their notes aloud at the beginning of every meeting.
sentences.ja: 毎回の会合の最初にノートを音読した。

sentences.en: However, they rarely discussed ideas beyond the written facts.
sentences.ja: しかし書かれた事実を超える考えを議論することはめったになかった。

sentences.en: One afternoon, Riku asked why many towns developed near rivers.
sentences.ja: ある午後リクはなぜ多くの町が川の近くで発展したのか尋ねた。

sentences.en: His classmates gave several possible answers instead of reading their notebooks.
sentences.ja: 仲間はノートを読む代わりに考えられる答えをいくつか述べた。

sentences.en: They realized that their textbook contained information related to the question.
sentences.ja: 教科書にその問いに関連する情報があると気づいた。

sentences.en: Together, they searched different chapters for evidence to support their answers.
sentences.ja: 一緒に別々の章から答えの根拠を探した。

sentences.en: The group decided to create a separate notebook of questions.
sentences.ja: グループは問いを記す別のノートを作ることにした。

sentences.en: Before each meeting, every member prepared at least one question.
sentences.ja: 毎回の会合前に各自少なくとも一つの問いを用意した。

sentences.en: Some questions required comparisons, while others asked for possible explanations.
sentences.ja: 比較を必要とする問いもあれば考えられる説明を求める問いもあった。

sentences.en: Members were encouraged to explain where their information came from.
sentences.ja: 情報の出所を説明するよう促された。

sentences.en: After several meetings, Riku looked back at the first questions they had written.
sentences.ja: 数回の会合後、最初に書いた問いを振り返った。

sentences.en: Some were too broad to answer with the available information.
sentences.ja: 利用可能な情報では答えられないほど広すぎるものもあった。

sentences.en: Others contained assumptions that needed to be examined before discussion.
sentences.ja: 議論前に検討が必要な前提を含むものもあった。

sentences.en: The group revised these questions and recorded the reasons for each change.
sentences.ja: 問いを修正しそれぞれの変更理由を記録した。

sentences.en: Riku still used his original notes when he needed to review important facts.
sentences.ja: 重要な事実を復習する際は元のノートも使った。

sentences.en: Yet the new notebook encouraged him to connect those facts in meaningful ways.
sentences.ja: しかし新しいノートは事実を意味のある形でつなぐことを促した。

sentences.en: He learned that a useful question can reveal gaps in his understanding.
sentences.ja: 有用な問いは理解の不足を明らかにできると学んだ。

sentences.en: For the group, learning included improving questions as well as finding answers.
sentences.ja: グループにとって学びには答えを見つけるだけでなく問いの改善も含まれた。

questions.prompt: What subject was the group studying?
What did the members do at first?
options: Took a test at every meeting.
Why many towns developed near rivers.
How to buy a new notebook.
questions.explanation_ja: 町が川辺で発展した理由。

questions.prompt: Why did they search different textbook chapters?
options: They needed evidence to support possible answers.
They wanted to avoid reading any facts.
The teacher had removed the answers.
They wanted to copy the same heading.
questions.explanation_ja: 答えを支える根拠を探した。

questions.prompt: What did each member prepare before a meeting?
options: A new map of the world.
questions.explanation_ja: 少なくとも一つの問い。

questions.prompt: What were members asked to explain?
Why did they revise some early questions?
options: All had already been answered perfectly.
The notebooks had no space left.
Some were too broad or contained unexamined assumptions.
questions.explanation_ja: 広すぎたり未検討の前提があったりした。

questions.prompt: Why did Riku keep using his original notes?
options: Reviewing important facts was still useful.
He wanted to abandon all questions.
The new notebook had been lost.
questions.explanation_ja: 事実の復習にも価値がある。

options: Good questions help learners connect facts and recognize gaps.
Learning is limited to reading facts aloud.
Students should never change their questions.
questions.explanation_ja: 良い問いは事実をつなぎ理解の不足を示す。
